# UX and Accessibility Checklist: Public Dashboard

**Purpose**: Check that the screen, state, theme and accessibility requirements are complete and clear before planning
**Created**: 2026-11-11
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `checklist` procedure based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are the phone and desktop width boundaries where the layout switches defined, or explicitly left to the design handoff? [Gap, Spec §FR-017]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the content of the "Coming soon" pages (heading, text, way back to the Dashboard) specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-016]
- [ ] CHK003 Is the station "location" shown in each ranking row defined (barangay, street address, or both)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK004 Are the page title and description for each page specified for search results and screen readers? [Gap, Spec §FR-015]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK005 Is the rounding of the city average (two decimals, rounded or truncated) specified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK006 Is the date format on the adjustment card ("As of Oct 27, 2026") fixed for all locales? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK007 Is "applied before the page is shown" stated in a way a test can observe? [Measurability, Spec §FR-019, SC-005]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK008 Do the tie-breaking rules for the ranking and "Cheapest in CDO" agree with each other? [Consistency, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK009 Is the "No change" state from the edge cases reflected in FR-009 and SC-002? [Consistency, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the mobile menu behavior (open, close, close on tab select, focus) consistent with the desktop tabs? [Consistency, Spec §FR-017]

## Scenario and Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK011 Is behavior defined when the page is open across midnight, so "Reported today" becomes stale? [Edge Case, Gap]
- [ ] CHK012 Are requirements defined for very long station, brand or product names in rows and cards? [Edge Case, Gap]
- [ ] CHK013 Is the Dashboard's behavior without JavaScript (fuel switch, pagination, mode toggle) specified? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK014 Is the error page's recovery path (retry, way back) defined? [Recovery, Spec §FR-014]

## Accessibility

- [ ] CHK015 Is the text alternative for each ranking bar defined (for example, price relative to the highest)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-023]
- [ ] CHK016 Is the accessible name for the selected fuel state (pressed or selected) specified, not only the highlight color? [Coverage, Spec §FR-002, FR-022]
- [ ] CHK017 Are reduced-motion requirements defined for the tab underline animation? [Gap, Spec §US3-6]
- [ ] CHK018 Is the 4.5:1 contrast target applied to the "est." label, legend and muted text in both modes? [Coverage, Spec §FR-022]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by the `specify` procedure and the `clarify` procedure
- `st-build` reads checklist state but does not modify markers
